scope: New isolated backend mission-permission regression tests only; no backend implementation, actual preview identity or operational data changes

tests.snapshot_scope: Records, versions, audit, outbox, idempotency, organisation sequences

tests.change_before_run: Strengthened denial snapshots to every persisted metadata table, including identity sessions/users, jobs and reservations; same10cases, not20distincttests

limits: This focused permission regression does not establish full paragraph acceptance, UI accessibility, all mission transitions, live operation permissions or the future candidate release gates.
